description:
Subject: Specification for New Rectangular Layout  

Dear Team,

Please prepare the upcoming floor plan using a rectangular footprint. The rectangle should have a length of 12.5 units and a width of 8.3 units. Ensure that these dimensions are applied consistently across all related drawings and material estimates.  

Let me know if any clarification is needed. Thank you.
